title: Artificial Intelligence - Class XII Student Handbook
objectives: Understand the fundamentals of Artificial Intelligence.
Explore the applications and implications of AI in various fields.
Develop skills in Python programming and data analysis.
Learn about neural networks and their applications.

contentBlocks.title: Introduction to Artificial Intelligence
contentBlocks.content: The world around us is undergoing a dramatic transformation, driven by the relentless advancement of Artificial Intelligence (AI). From self-driving cars navigating city streets to virtual assistants understanding complex inquiries, AI is rapidly reshaping industries, societies, and the very way we interact with technology.
contentBlocks.keyTakeaway: AI is transforming industries and society.

contentBlocks.title: Curriculum Overview
contentBlocks.content: This revised textbook dives into the captivating world of AI, offering a comprehensive exploration of its core concepts, applications, and potential impact. The curriculum aligns with industry standards as set forth by the National Skills Qualification Framework (NSQF) at Levels 3 & 4.
contentBlocks.keyTakeaway: The curriculum provides a comprehensive exploration of AI.

contentBlocks.title: Unit 1: Python Programming-II
contentBlocks.content: This chapter provides a comprehensive review of fundamental Python programming and techniques. Students will gain hands-on experience with essential Python libraries, preparing them for more advanced data analysis and machine learning tasks.
contentBlocks.keyTakeaway: Students will enhance their Python programming skills.

contentBlocks.title: Understanding Neural Networks
contentBlocks.content: A neural network is a machine learning program that makes decisions in a manner similar to the human brain, using processes that mimic the way biological neurons work together to identify phenomena, weigh options, and arrive at conclusions.
contentBlocks.keyTakeaway: Neural networks mimic human brain processes for decision-making.

contentBlocks.title: Generative AI
contentBlocks.content: Generative AI creates diverse content like audio, text, images, and more, aiming to generate new data resembling its training samples. It utilizes machine learning algorithms to achieve this, learning from existing datasets.
contentBlocks.keyTakeaway: Generative AI can create new content based on learned patterns.

contentBlocks.title: Data Storytelling
contentBlocks.content: Data storytelling is the art and practice of translating complex data and analytics into a compelling narrative that is easily understandable and relatable to various audiences. It combines data, visuals, and narrative to present complex information engagingly.
contentBlocks.keyTakeaway: Data storytelling enhances comprehension and impact of data insights.

questions.question: Which of the following is a primary data structure in Pandas?
What does the fillna(0) function do in Pandas?
options: a) Removes rows with missing values
b) Fills missing values with zeros
c) Estimates missing values based on averages
d) Converts all data to zero
questions.answer: b) Fills missing values with zeros
